label: removes-undocumented-fleet-fields-issuing
content:
# Removes undocumented fleet fields

## What’s new

Removes the following undocumented `fleet` fields from the [Issuing Transaction](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/transactions/object.md?api-version=2024-06-20) resource in favor of their corresponding `_decimal` equivalents:

- `purchase_details.fleet.reported_breakdown.fuel.gross_amount`
- `purchase_details.fleet.reported_breakdown.non_fuel.gross_amount`
- `purchase_details.fleet.reported_breakdown.tax.local_amount`
- `purchase_details.fleet.reported_breakdown.tax.national_amount`

## Impact

This change removes undocumented fleet fields from the `Issuing Transaction` resource, replacing them with decimal equivalents. You need to update your code to use the new `_decimal` fields for more precise financial reporting.

## Upgrade

#### REST API

1. [View your current API version](https://docs.stripe.com/workbench/guides.md#view-api-versions) in Workbench.
2. If you use an SDK, upgrade to the corresponding SDK version for this API version.
- If you don’t use an SDK, update your [API requests](https://docs.stripe.com/api-versions.md#how-versions-are-specified-in-requests) to include `Stripe-Version: 2024-06-20`
3. Upgrade the API version used for [webhook endpoints](https://docs.stripe.com/webhooks/versioning.md).
4. [Test your integration](https://docs.stripe.com/testing.md) against the new version.
5. If you use Connect, [test your Connect integration](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/testing.md).

Learn more about [Stripe API upgrades](https://docs.stripe.com/upgrades.md).
